chapter: Kansas City bands and the Blue Devils
title: Gene Coy's Black Aces in Oklahoma
summary: Gene Coy's band played the Blue Glass Ballroom in Oklahoma, with his cousins Allen on trombone and Clyde on bass getting him in.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: But, you know, I mean, we're talking really of probably 1922, and we've got -- let's see, you don't get with Benny Morton -- oh, Morton you get with in 1929. And -- well, do you remember anything about Gene Coin's band?
Yeah, that was in Shiny, Oklahoma, the Blueglass Ballroom.
For the Frederick Brothers, who come to New York for awhile, who I got (inaudible) buddies when they moved here. So, Gene Coin's Black Aces, that's who that was, and Clyde was with the band.
Not Clyde, Alan Era. Yeah, Clyde was there, too, both of them.
Yeah, and Clyde was playing bass, and that's how I think they got me in there.
